scenes.text: How does Spring know what to inject?
scenes.phonemes: hˌaʊ dˈʌz spɹˈɪŋ nˈoʊ wʌt tʊ ɪndʒˈɛkt?

scenes.text: The order service constructor requests a PaymentGateway. Spring reads that dependency.
scenes.phonemes: ðɪ ˈɔːɹdɚ sˈɜːvɪs kənstɹˈʌktɚ ɹᵻkwˈɛsts ɐ pˈeɪmənt ɡˈeɪtweɪ. spɹˈɪŋ ɹˈiːdz ðæt dᵻpˈɛndənsi.

scenes.text: The bean factory finds compatible types. An unrelated logger won't match. Matching beans must also be eligible.
scenes.phonemes: ðə bˈiːn fˈæktɚɹi fˈaɪndz kəmpˈæɾᵻbəl tˈaɪps. ɐn ˌʌnɹᵻlˈeɪɾᵻd lˈɔɡɚ woʊnt mˈætʃ. mˈætʃɪŋ bˈiːnz mˈʌst ˈɔːlsoʊ biː ˈɛlɪdʒəbəl.

scenes.text: Here, one eligible gateway remains. Spring supplies its instance to the constructor.
scenes.phonemes: hˈɪɹ, wˈʌn ˈɛlɪdʒəbəl ɡˈeɪtweɪ ɹᵻmˈeɪnz. spɹˈɪŋ səplˈaɪz ɪts ˈɪnstəns tə ðə kənstɹˈʌktɚ.

scenes.text: Without an eligible candidate, this required constructor dependency stops context startup.
scenes.phonemes: wɪðˌaʊt ɐn ˈɛlɪdʒəbəl kˈændᵻdˌeɪt, ðɪs ɹᵻkwˈaɪɚd kənstɹˈʌktɚ dᵻpˈɛndənsi stˈɑːps kˈɑːntɛkst stˈɑːɹɾʌp.

scenes.text: Our tests verify both outcomes. Qualifiers and primary settings can also affect selection. Match, filter, inject.
scenes.phonemes: ˌaʊɚ tˈɛsts vˈɛɹᵻfˌaɪ bˈoʊθ ˈaʊtkʌmz. kwˈɔlɪfˌaɪɚz ænd pɹˈaɪmɚɹi sˈɛɾɪŋz kæn ˈɔːlsoʊ ɐfˈɛkt sᵻlˈɛkʃən. mˈætʃ, fˈɪltɚ, ɪndʒˈɛkt.
